[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lemon Rosemary Chicken Breasts: Marinate chicken breasts in lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, and chopped rosemary; grill and serve with quinoa and roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chipotle Lime Chicken: Marinate chicken breasts in lime juice, olive oil, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, and cumin; grill and serve with brown rice and sautéed bell peppers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provides a list of baked chicken recipes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs: Mix honey, Dijon mustard, and chopped thyme; brush on chicken thighs and bake with sliced carrots and Brussels sprouts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Greek-Style Chicken Breasts: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and oregano; brush on chicken breasts and bake with sliced zucchini and cherry tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provides a list of slow cooker chicken recipes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Cilantro Lime Chicken: Cook chicken breasts, diced onion, cilantro, lime juice, and chicken broth in a slow cooker on low for 6-8 hours; shred and serve with brown rice and steamed broccoli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Indian-Style Chicken Curry: Cook chicken breasts, diced onion, curry powder, coconut milk, and diced tomatoes in a slow cooker on low for 6-8 hours; serve with brown rice and sautéed spinach.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provides a list of stir-fry chicken recipes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Korean-Style Chicken and Veggies: Stir-fry diced chicken breast with Korean chili flakes, soy sauce, and sesame oil; add veggies and serve with brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Thai-Style Chicken and Basil: Stir-fry diced chicken breast with Thai red curry paste, coconut milk, and chopped basil; add veggies and serve with brown rice.
